name: Blueprint Explainer
tagline: Thin line drawings on a navy grid, a needle that sweeps, a formula that writes itself and calm subtitles.
description: Patient teaching style for science, maths and how-it-works explainers. White and cyan line art draws itself on a navy blueprint grid, a gauge needle sweeps into place, an italic serif formula writes on letter by letter, measurements appear in amber mono, and one subtitle line at the bottom narrates each step.

display.usage: Formulas 76–92px; variables in italic, operators upright

transitions: no cuts: elements draw on, fade up 20px or fade out in place
textAnimations: formula writes on character by character (40ms)
amber underline draws beneath the key line
timer counts with the motion (0:00 → 2:00 h)
needle wobbles gently to show an instantaneous value

rhythm.notes: One idea per ~2.2s beat, each with exactly one subtitle. Give drawings time to finish before the next line appears.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Navy #0f1626 with a faint 60px grid (1px lines in rgba(122,140,170,0.08)). Draw everything as 3–5px strokes with round caps; no fills except tiny hubs.
- Colour by role: the subject in cyan #7fd3ff, structure and axes in off-white #e8edf5, measurements in amber #ffc857, warnings and needles in coral #ff6b6b, secondary marks in muted #7a869c (dashed 28/22).
- Draw lines on with pathLength=1 and dashoffset 1→0 (power2.inOut); other elements fade up 20px or fade out in place. No cuts and no camera moves.
- Measure things visibly: drawn brackets, tick marks and amber IBM Plex Mono 500 readouts (30px) that count with the motion. When the motion itself is being measured, move at constant speed (ease none); dials and needles settle with back.out(1.6) and a small wobble.
- Formulas in STIX Two Text 500, 76–92px: italic variables, upright operators, written on letter by letter (~40ms) with an amber underline drawn beneath the key term.
- Keep exactly one plain-language subtitle at the bottom (IBM Plex Sans, 34px), phrased as a narrator would say it; crossfade between them (0.3s out, 0.4s in). Questions sit at 64px in muted.
- One idea per ~2.2s beat; let each drawing finish before the next line appears. Build to a question, then answer it in amber italic.
- Avoid filled shapes, photos, gradients, glow and fast cuts.
example: The preview explains a car's speedometer: a line-drawn car on a road, a gauge needle at 60 km/h, the formula 120 km ÷ 2 h = 60 km/h, and the answer that the needle shows speed at one instant. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
